## IrmConfigFactory #1

Inverts the adaptive reuse check, so a registered params set is redeployed over its row and a new one returns zero.

- **Mutant:** [`1.sol`](1.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`vtIcfAdaptiveRegistryIsWriteOnce`](../../specs/IrmConfigFactory/IrmConfigFactory_properties.spec#L11)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmConfigFactory 1`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmConfigFactory/properties.conf --rule vtIcfAdaptiveRegistryIsWriteOnce`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-config-factory/IrmConfigFactory.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-config-factory/IrmConfigFactory.sol
@@ -31,7 +31,7 @@
         bytes32 paramsHash = keccak256(abi.encode(params));
         config = _adaptiveCurveConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash];

-        if (config == address(0)) {
+        if (config != address(0)) {
             config = address(new AdaptiveCurveConfig(params));
             _adaptiveCurveConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash] = config;
             emit AdaptiveCurveConfigDeployed(paramsHash, config);
```

```diff
     }
```

## IrmConfigFactory #3013

Writes the linear kink registry before deploying, so the row stays empty and every request deploys another config.

- **Mutant:** [`3013.sol`](3013.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`utIcfGetOrDeployLinearRegistersTheReturnedConfig`](../../specs/IrmConfigFactory/IrmConfigFactory_properties.spec#L114)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh IrmConfigFactory 3013`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmConfigFactory/properties.conf --rule utIcfGetOrDeployLinearRegistersTheReturnedConfig`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-config-factory/IrmConfigFactory.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-config-factory/IrmConfigFactory.sol
@@ -44,8 +44,8 @@
         config = _linearKinkConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash];

         if (config == address(0)) {
+            _linearKinkConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash] = config;
             config = address(new LinearKinkConfig(params));
-            _linearKinkConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash] = config;
             emit LinearKinkConfigDeployed(paramsHash, config);
         }
     }
```

## IrmConfigFactory #3014

Writes every linear kink deployment into the adaptive registry as well.

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-config-factory/IrmConfigFactory.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/irm-config-factory/IrmConfigFactory.sol
@@ -45,7 +45,7 @@

         if (config == address(0)) {
             config = address(new LinearKinkConfig(params));
-            _linearKinkConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash] = config;
+            _linearKinkConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash] = config; _adaptiveCurveConfigByParamsHash[paramsHash] = config;
```
